name: account_match
_comment: T207: both clients sign up on the dedicated server's TLS account endpoint (port + 1) the way the Account screen does, then join through the real menus signed in (session token in the auth handshake). The server ends the match at tick 240: accounts checks each account's result was applied on the server, sent back to the player (client profile = server's), and not written to the client's local profile.cfg. T534: duration 600 -> 900 -- on the bad link a client that joins late through the menus could reach its own 600 ticks (counted from its start) before the match end + profile arrived (client_2 quit at arena tick 254, the end came at ~276).
